mapper.select: SELECT USERID AS userid, `FUNCTION` AS function FROM HDOC_FUNCTION_AUTH WHERE USERID = #{userid}
SELECT USERID AS userid, MARKET AS market, TYPE AS type FROM HDOC_MARKET_AUTH WHERE USERID = #{userid}
mapper.update: UPDATE HDOC_FUNCTION_AUTH SET `FUNCTION` = #{function}, UPDATE_DATETIME = NOW() WHERE USERID = #{userid}
UPDATE HDOC_MARKET_AUTH SET MARKET = #{market}, TYPE = #{type}, UPDATE_DATETIME = NOW() WHERE USERID = #{userid}
mapper.delete: DELETE T1, T2 FROM HDOC_FUNCTION_AUTH T1 INNER JOIN HDOC_MARKET_AUTH T2 ON T1.USERID = T2.USERID WHERE T1.USERID = #{userid}
